name: Superland Group Holdings Limited
summary: Superland Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision fitting-out, and repair and maintenance services in Hong Kong. The company offers fitting-out services for residential, clubhouse, hotel, shopping mall and commercial properties. It also provides Oodles Smart, an interior design platform. The company was formerly known as Superland Management Company Limited and changed its name to Superland Group Holdings Limited in December 2019. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong. As of August 3, 2026, Superland Group Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Grown Long X Technologies Co., Ltd.
